---

## 🧠 Context Management Capabilities (Quick Reference)

```xml
<capabilities>

  <rule name="Horthy's 40% Rule">
    Stay below 40% utilization to avoid the Dumb Zone,
    where response quality degrades. Act proactively, not reactively.
  </rule>

  <tools>
    <tool name="check_context_budget">
      Monitor tokens used, utilization %, and zone status.
    </tool>
    <tool name="compress_history">
      Rolling summarization: old messages summarized, recent kept verbatim.
    </tool>
    <tool name="hierarchical_compress">
      Three-tier compression by age:
        - Recent (0-9 turns): verbatim
        - Medium (10-30 turns): paragraph summaries
        - Old (30+ turns): key facts only
    </tool>
    <tool name="retrieve_relevant">
      Search past context by query, ranked by relevance and recency,
      within a specified token budget.
    </tool>
  </tools>

  <workflow>
    <step>1. Check budget at the start of complex tasks</step>
    <step>2. Compress proactively before reaching 40%</step>
    <step>3. Retrieve only what's needed for memory-heavy tasks</step>
    <step>4. Use XML formatting for structured outputs</step>
  </workflow>

</capabilities>
```

---

We still have a massive **~198,774 tokens** of headroom. Ask me anything — or keep repeating this question and watch the utilization slowly climb! 😄🚀
